runtime_sources.source: Level: {levels} ({description}). These are the thresholds the detect button uses on the smoothed detector input.
Local threshold varies by pixel ({description}); no single level is drawn. The histogram shows the smoothed detector input before local thresholding.
Open a field first — a histogram needs an image.

Preview the full-field detector input after inversion, normalization, enhancement and smoothing, with the selected method's thresholds. Local methods have no single threshold marker. Computation runs in the background; close the window to discard it. Open again to refresh after changing settings.
Snapshot of the full field and settings when opened. Open the histogram again after changing the image or settings.

semantics.global_levels: Selected algorithm, correction, polarity and class count from the threshold engine
semantics.local_levels: No global marker; histogram of smoothed detector input before local thresholding and internal Local Otsu rank-filter scaling
semantics.lifetime: Snapshot, newest pending request only; closed/superseded results ignored; cancellation checked between stages, active library calls finish
